states.IMPLEMENTED_AND_VALIDATED: Code + tests present AND backed by real read-only live evidence.
states.IMPLEMENTED_BUT_AUTH_REQUIRED: Code present but requires external API credentials to operate; fails closed without them.
states.IMPLEMENTED_BUT_LIQUIDITY_UNPROVEN: Code + tests present but real on-chain liquidity/quote not yet proven live.
states.UNSUPPORTED: Deliberately not supported (e.g. provider not deployed on chain).
states.VALIDATION_REQUIRED: Implemented with unit/mocked tests only; real VPS validation outstanding.

status_semantics.implementation_status: What the code + offline/mocked tests establish (Emergent responsibility).
status_semantics.live_validation_status: What real six-chain read-only VPS evidence establishes (Codex responsibility). 'NONE' until Codex validates.
